_about: Public-domain Anthony Norris Groves (1795-1853, missionary to Baghdad and India, early Brethren) for the Word Hoard: Christian Devotedness (second edition, 1829) and Journal of a Residence at Bagdad (1832, introduced by A. J. Scott), both from Project Gutenberg. The Gutenberg Christian Devotedness carries a short note by a later, unnamed editor. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 21 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
